tasks.short: Review environmental, historical and technical publications for accuracy

steps.what: Locate and read the actual source evidence, earlier versions and cited publications supporting the report under review
inputs: actual report version under review
its source data, cited publications and earlier versions
outputs: geoscientist-read supporting evidence and missing-source list

steps.what: Evaluate the report's claims, calculations, historical interpretation, methods and conclusions against the actual evidence
inputs: actual report version under review
geoscientist-read supporting evidence and missing-source list
outputs: geoscientist's accuracy findings and unresolved substantive issues

steps.what: Write the actual review comments and corrections and check them against the precise report passages
inputs: geoscientist's accuracy findings and unresolved substantive issues
actual report version under review
outputs: complete checked accuracy-review comments for the report version

steps.what: Save the completed review comments against the report version in the existing document workspace
inputs: complete checked accuracy-review comments for the report version

tasks.design: Configure source links, full-text search and version views in {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the scientific-source library. These shorten evidence navigation; the geoscientist evaluates accuracy and writes the actual review comments before saving them against the reviewed version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checking a report can require repeated navigation between citations, data and earlier versions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document and library views can expose existing evidence together.
tasks.still_hard: Plausible text and consistent numbers can still conceal unsupported scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the strength and limits of the evidence rather than just citation presence.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for source licences and review permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source and version views can reduce navigation during scientific accuracy review without deciding whether the report is correct.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, unmeasured work scenarios. Only source navigation changes; review comments have no invented automation saving.
OTHER means scientific-source libraries and analysis viewers. The report author supplies the actual report and citations; data owners supply original evidence. Missing sources remain explicit.
No structured claim database or automatic semantic verdict is assumed. Existing equivalent views remove the saving.
Gross provisional saving 4 minus 0.5 hour of source-link upkeep gives 3.5 net. Same-system save is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Source availability and current review navigation effort
research_questions: Which real accuracy reviews require repeated source/version navigation that native views can remove?

already_counted.description: Read evidence, assess accuracy and write checked review comments

incremental.description: Check source links and library access paths

approvals.approved_version: complete checked accuracy-review comments for the report version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.5%; accuracy judgment and review writing remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify deposits suitable for construction materials

steps.what: Read existing geological maps, borehole records and relevant material specifications for the actual candidate area
inputs: actual candidate area and intended construction-material application
existing geological maps, borehole records and material specifications
outputs: geoscientist-checked candidate evidence and investigation gaps

steps.what: Investigate the candidate deposit in the field and collect actual observations and samples
inputs: geoscientist-checked candidate evidence and investigation gaps
actual accessible deposit and sampling equipment
outputs: actual deposit observations and identified samples

steps.what: Read and validate the actual sample test results and relate them to the observed deposit and intended application
inputs: actual deposit observations and identified samples
laboratory's actual sample-linked material test results
outputs: geoscientist-checked material properties and testing limitations

steps.what: Identify deposits of construction materials suitable for concrete aggregates, road fill or the actual specified application, and complete the checked finding with limits and investigation needs
inputs: geoscientist-checked candidate evidence and investigation gaps
actual deposit observations and identified samples
geoscientist-checked material properties and testing limitations

steps.what: Save the completed deposit identification in the existing investigation workspace
inputs: complete checked construction-material deposit identification

tasks.design: Configure a native spatial view of existing geological and borehole records in {OTHER}, the geoscience mapping application. The geoscientist still investigates the deposit, checks actual sample-linked tests and determines suitability before recording the checked identification in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Candidate evidence can require repeated navigation between maps and borehole references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native spatial layers can expose existing referenced records together.
tasks.still_hard: Heterogeneous deposits and application-specific properties require representative sampling and interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether the evidence supports a usable deposit and where further investigation is needed.

ambition.what: No new extraction or certification authority proposed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for geological and borehole data access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: geoscience mapping views can link existing geological and borehole evidence; material suitability still depends on investigation and actual test results.

assumptions: Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. OTHER means existing geoscience mapping and laboratory-result viewers.

Existing data owners supply borehole locations and records. The geoscientist captures observations/samples in s2; the laboratory supplies sample identity, test method, result and units as existing outputs.
Laboratory processing is outside focal-role time and earns no saving. Missing locations or unmatched sample results require manual investigation.
Gross provisional saving 2.5 minus 0.5 hour of layer/link upkeep gives 2 net; existing equivalent spatial views remove the gain.
The actual identification is recorded separately from fieldwork; no automatic suitability decision, extraction permit or invented long report is proposed.
unknowns: Existing spatial links and sample representativeness
research_questions: Can existing native layers shorten actual candidate-evidence navigation without new data capture?

already_counted.description: Read candidate evidence, inspect tests and determine deposit suitability

incremental.description: Check map layer references and borehole links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2%; physical investigation and suitability interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Map mine geology, monitor integrity and advise mining crews

steps.what: Read actual mine survey/geology records and available structural-monitoring measurements for the area
inputs: actual mine survey and geological records
actual monitoring measurements with locations, times and units
outputs: geoscientist-checked mine evidence and missing-data list

steps.what: Design or revise and check the geological mine map using the actual survey evidence and interpreted structures
inputs: geoscientist-checked mine evidence and missing-data list
existing mine map and actual mapping conventions
outputs: complete checked geological mine map version

steps.what: Save the completed checked mine map in the existing mine project workspace
inputs: complete checked geological mine map version

steps.what: Inspect actual mine conditions and structural behaviour and monitor the crews' work for geological concerns
inputs: saved checked geological mine map
actual mine conditions, measurements and crew work
outputs: actual structural-integrity observations and crew-work concerns

steps.what: Explain actual geological concerns to the mining crews and advise on the appropriate work response
inputs: actual structural-integrity observations and crew-work concerns
crew's actual questions and operational constraints
outputs: actual geological advice and crew discussion

tasks.design: Configure existing spatial/status views and coordinate-linked map objects in {OTHER}, the mine mapping and monitoring applications. The geoscientist interprets the geology, completes the map and saves its checked version; actual structural inspection and crew advice remain human work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and manual transfer of known geometry can accompany mine mapping.
tasks.enabler_now: Native spatial links and drawing objects can reuse existing surveyed geometry.
tasks.still_hard: Structural hazards and changing mine conditions require direct observation and geological judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Connect uncertain geological evidence with the actual work crews are doing.

ambition.what: No automatic hazard clearance or machine control proposed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for mine data and operational access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native spatial and drawing tools can reuse surveyed geometry, while geological interpretation and mine-condition assessment require professional judgment.

assumptions: Shares are one provisional combined map/monitor/advice episode, not a claim that every mine assignment contains all alternatives in equal proportions.

OTHER means mine mapping and monitoring applications. Survey/monitoring teams already produce coordinates and timestamped measurements; no missing telemetry or structured hazard classification is assumed.
Only source navigation and known-geometry transfer change. Interpretation, field inspection and crew advice remain fully retained; missing or inconsistent evidence returns to investigation.
Gross provisional saving 5.75 minus 1.5 hours of source-layer and drawing-link upkeep gives 4.25 net. Existing equivalent native links remove the gain.
The map save is negligible and fully retained. No hidden alert, crew instruction send or automatic operational decision is proposed.
unknowns: Current mine mapping links and actual task mix
research_questions: Which actual map revisions still transfer known geometry manually despite native links?

already_counted.description: Read evidence and complete/check the geological map

incremental.description: Maintain source layers, coordinate mappings and drawing links

approvals.approved_version: complete checked geological mine map version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 4.25%; no saving in physical monitoring or crew discussion.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify new platinum-group-element sources for industrial use

steps.what: Read actual regional geology, exploration records, assay evidence and relevant research for candidate platinum-group-element sources
inputs: actual candidate-region question and intended industrial requirements
existing geological records, exploration/assay reports and research

steps.what: Conduct the actual geological investigation and examine candidate material and sample-linked analytical results
inputs: geoscientist-checked candidate-source evidence and uncertainty
actual accessible candidate material and laboratory results
outputs: actual investigation observations and checked analytical evidence

steps.what: Interpret the geological and analytical evidence and complete the checked candidate-source finding with limits on industrial suitability
inputs: geoscientist-checked candidate-source evidence and uncertainty
actual investigation observations and checked analytical evidence

steps.what: Save the completed checked candidate-source finding in the existing research workspace
inputs: complete checked platinum-group source finding

tasks.design: Configure native topic, region and source filters in {OTHER}, the geological-data and scientific-library applications, to expose actual candidate evidence. The geoscientist conducts the investigation and interprets source potential, then records the checked finding in {DOCS}; a search result never becomes a discovered deposit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Candidate exploration evidence can be scattered across research and regional archives.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed views can shorten source discovery without generating geological evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Mineral presence does not establish recoverability, scale or industrial suitability.
tasks.human_edge: Form and test a defensible geological explanation for a genuinely promising source.

ambition.what: No new deposit discovery or extraction yield claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-5 for geological/assay data and source licences

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed geological and research-source views can support exploration research without establishing a new viable mineral source.

assumptions: Shares are unmeasured provisional work allocation. OTHER means geological-data, assay-result and scientific-library viewers.

Existing exploration teams, laboratories and publishers supply actual records; the geoscientist checks source provenance. Missing coordinates, sample identities or assay context require manual investigation.
Only indexed discovery changes. Field investigation, analysis interpretation and the substantive finding remain unchanged; existing equivalent search removes the gain.
Gross provisional saving 3 minus 0.5 hour of source-filter upkeep gives 2.5 net. Same-system save is fully retained.
No fabricated quantity, commercial viability estimate or automatic notification is proposed.
unknowns: Current research retrieval friction and data completeness
research_questions: Do actual candidate investigations repeat source searches that native indexed views can shorten?

incremental.description: Check source filters and archive references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.5%; discovery and substantive interpretation remain uncertain human work.
